reviews.title: ASUS ROG STRIX is versatile and operates in multiple configurations
reviews.comment:
I bought this ROG STRIX X870E-E Gaming WiFi motherboard to replace an old INTEL build, which crashed. I added a AMD Ryzen 9 9900X 12-Core Processor, 64.0 GB (61.6 GB usable) , AMD Radeon RX6600,2 SAMSUNG SSD 900 Pro 4TB
2 ST8000 drives from my old build, DVD Player, and a G915YKL keyboard. I installed all this in my old Thermaltake case. Finally, I added a Samsung Odyssey G80 monitor. This system flies. Files load instantly, as do processes.  Colors are bright and sharp.
reviews.author: Robert S. Baldassano
